text:
Incident Bot: ALERT — detected elevated p95 latency and reduced throughput on eu inference cluster (eu-prod). Auto-threshold triggered at 2026-03-15T01:00Z. Paging on-call SRE now. :rotating_light:
Maria L.: i'm on it, seeing p95 ~1.2s for gen endpoints and throughput down ~28% across small-model routes. errors ~0.5% increase (502/504).
Dan O.: thanks maria. are we seeing GPU errors or network? any task evictions?
Maria L.: digging into node metrics. a subset of dedicated pool nodes showing thermal throttling and elevated GPU SM utilization. some preempt events on spot nodes in the pool.
Ashok R.: ok, immediate mitigations we can try: 1) shift traffic off affected pool to spare pool (route rule), 2) spin up hot warm nodes in eu, 3) fallback to quantized variant for >=2k token requests.
Olivia S.: heads up for comms — i'll draft a short status page update once we have impact and ETA.
Dan O.: can someone run traffic shift? i'll prepare the rollback plan.
Maria L.: running routing change now: `redwood route update --from pool:eu-prod-b --to pool:eu-prod-spare --weight 0.4 --routes '*/gen/*'`
Maria L.: routing change applied, shifting 40% of gen traffic off eu-prod-b -> spare. monitoring.
Support Bot: customer impacts observed: a handful of enterprise tenants in EU with heavy conversational workloads showing token delays and occasional 5xx. No full outages reported. queued support tickets: 12.
Olivia S.: DRAFT status page snippet (please edit):
```
Incident: Elevated inference latency in EU region
Status: Investigating
Impact: Intermittent high latency (p95 ~1.2s) and reduced throughput for some text-generation endpoints in EU. Affected customers may see slower responses or occasional request failures.
Mitigation: Traffic is being routed away from affected nodes and additional capacity is being provisioned.
Next update: in 20 minutes or when we have ETA for full recovery.
```
Maria L.: additional telemetry: top offender models are small-medium LLaMA variants on quantization boundary; CPU schedulers on some nodes at 95%.
Ashok R.: i'll start scaling the dedicated pool: `rctl pool scale --pool eu-prod-hot --min-instances 4 --target-gpu 16` — kicking that off now.
Dan O.: adding temporary fallback policy in routing to prefer quantized-8 variants for routes with >1s median latency. command: `redwood policy create --name fallback-quant8 --match 'route:gen*' --action 'model:quant8,weight:0.5'`
Maria L.: autoscale job started, new nodes booting. observed steady decrease in error rate after routing change but p95 still ~900-1000ms.
Olivia S.: Support note for CS: "We're investigating elevated inference latency in EU. Mitigations in progress; you can share the status page snippet below. We'll notify affected customers directly if their SLAs are at risk."
Support Bot: sending proactive note to tenants in impacted tag 'eu-heavy' with template draft (ok to send after exec approval).
Olivia S.: CUSTOMER-NOTICE DRAFT (short):
```
Hi <customer>,
We detected elevated latency affecting inference in our EU region. We're routing traffic away from impacted nodes and provisioning additional capacity. You may see slower responses for a short time. We're working on a full recovery and will follow up with updates.
Estimated recovery: within 30-45 minutes.
If you rely on strict SLOs, reply and we'll escalate.
Thanks, Redwood Inference
```
Dan O.: quick check — any impact to embeddings or is it just generation?
Maria L.: embeddings unaffected (different pool). only gen endpoints that share token pipeline and KV cache.
Ashok R.: node boots done, rolling warm pool join. i've also disabled one suspect node (eu-prod-b-7) that had persistent SM resets.
Maria L.: after disabling node, p95 improved to ~700ms. throughput trending up. 5xxs dropping.
Dan O.: nice. let's keep routing change in place until pool stabilization. set a 2 hour TTL on the change so it auto-reverts if we forget.
Maria L.: set TTL: `redwood route update --id <route-id> --ttl 7200` — done.
Olivia S.: updating status page now with current state and ETA 30min. posting internal summary in ops channel in 10.
Support Bot: ticket update queued for 12 SKUs with impact tag. template includes link to status page.
Dan O.: preparing handoff notes for next on-call (shift ends in ~35m). Maria, can you capture actions left?
Maria L.: Handoff checklist:
- monitor p95 and 5xx for next 60m (watch EU gen routes)
- validate new nodes healthy and KV cache warm (rerun cache-warm script if necessary) `scripts/cache_warm --region eu --models small,med`
- keep routing rule in place until pool stable (TTL 2h)
- if p95 >1.0s after 45m, escalate to infra leads for emergency scale and consider temporary global routing to us-west spare nodes
- customer comms: Olivia to publish status page + send proactive notices to impacted tenants

Ashok R.: added myself as secondary owner for scaling ops. if we see SM resets again, we should cordon batch workloads from those nodes.
Olivia S.: internal ops blurb (for ops channel):
```
[OPS] 01:00Z - Investigating elevated inference latency in EU. Traffic partially shifted to spare pool; additional hot nodes added. Estimated recovery 30-45m. Owners: Maria L., Dan O., Ashok R.
```
Dan O.: ok i'm handing off to @<next-oncall> — will stay on-call async for 15m then fully handover. please escalate to me if recovery stalls.
Maria L.: handing docs + links: grafana dashboards, route config, pool events: https://grafana.internal/r/inf-eu; https://console.internal/pools/eu-prod; https://incidents.internal/1845001234
Support Bot: marking thread with 'customer-notified' once Olivia publishes.
Olivia S.: published status page update and sent customer notices to impacted tag. posted links in thread.
Maria L.: system metrics now p95 ~420ms, throughput near baseline. closing monitoring window to 60m; will update if regress.
Dan O.: great work team. I'll close the page once the 60m stabilization window is complete and no regressions. :thumbsup:
Olivia S.: final note for postmortem — please capture root cause: thermal/SM resets on subset of dedicated nodes and spot eviction overlap during autoscale. action items: improve node health checks, reserve non-preemptible capacity for min baseline, add auto-failover to spare pools earlier.
Incident Bot: Incident update — status changed to: Monitoring. Time: 2026-03-15T02:05Z.
